1669-3293-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1669-3293-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1669-3293-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

323-1981-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
323-1981-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-3033-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

6034-7074-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
6034-7074-8089.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2034-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

301-1453-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

4871-5686-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-5686-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Shilgengar four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4419-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

1172-1624-5957.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

140-5174-7433.description:
Activate Immolating Souleater by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

1558-3147-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3147-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

489-1020-2034-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Nylea.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Nylea.
Repeat.

1734-5231-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

57-2751-4846-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

645-1267-2438-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2438-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

3330-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3330-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2201-2558-5226-5687.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3869-4067-4188.notablePrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 4 life this turn.
3869-4067-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

1355-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least two enchantments.
1355-1909-4486.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.
1355-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

791-3693-5426-5427.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5426-5427.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling all damage dealt by sources you control this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

866-2661-5125.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
866-2661-5125.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Sparkcaster for its blitz cost by paying {R}{G}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sparkcaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second triggers, dealing 1 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Repeat.

1912-2043-2470-3263.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Urza by paying at most {2}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may target any other permanent using Urza's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-5174.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.
4567-5174.description:
Activate Immolating Souleater by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

1867-2206-2557-4231-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Vegetation Abomination to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Vegetation Abomination by paying {2}{G}.
When Vegetation Abomination enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Vegetation Abomination and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

888-898-1173-5261.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{R} on your first turn, with {2} available on each extra turn
888-898-1173-5261.description:
Cast Isochron Scepter by paying {2}.
Isochron Scepter enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Isochron Scepter's trigger.
Resolve both Isochron Scepter triggers, exiling Stifle and Final Fortune from your hand.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of the end step during your extra turn, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding prioirty, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Stifle and Final Fortune without paying their mana cost.
Resolve Stifle, countering Final Fortune's trigger from step 8.
Repeat from step 6.

1308-2557-3209-4772.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback for {4}{G}, creating eight 1/1 green Saproling token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback, tapping five green 1/1 Saproling tokens to pay for it using convoke.
Repeat from step 2.

3846-3851-4600.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
Blade of Selves attached to Atemsis.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values.
3846-3851-4600.description:
Declare Atemsis as an attacker.
Atemsis' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Atemsis tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using each Atemsis, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Atemsis trigger, causing you to reveal your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.
